entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3027940437469882880: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ CMa: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1633.3 +/- 133.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1633.3 +/- 133.3 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.5627 +/- 0.0236 mas (same row, RUWE 1.63), 23.8 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -1.461, 0.944 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 31.3 +/- 2.6 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ CMa: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 31.3 +/- 2.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 6000 +/- 361 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 144, Name='RZ CMa', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 6000 +/- 361 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 6,000 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.443 +/- 0.016 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff3f0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,000 K and log g 1.1 (u1 0.523, u2 0.172): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Unmeasured, bounded: no gravity of this star is published (none in SIMBAD); Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, table 3 (the spectroscopic gravities of its Cepheid spectra) gives the class's range, log g -1.33 to 2.86. Across log g 0 to 2.85, the part the grid covers, the limb laws differ by at most 3.0% of the centre brightness from the one drawn, at log g 1.1, the gravity closest to all of them; log g 1.1 is a display choice, not a measurement.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 3027940437469882880: 2 G-band harmonics of a 4.255355692616744 d period, peak-to-peak 0.521 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.05 of a cycle there.
